overview_description.description:
Meteor is a 100% remote company that covers the massive disruptions caused by new technologies like AI, Web3, and NFTs.  

Meteor is centered on the upcoming aspects of subjects that arouse enthusiasm, ranging from art, games, and music to media and sports.

The company was founded in 2022 by Neil Katz and Evan Hansen.

competitors_list.target_short_description: The Defiant operates as an information company at the intersection of tech and finance.
Decrypt is a media platform that focused on stories from culture, technology, business, education, politics, art, and the latest news.
Cointelegraph covers fintech, blockchain, and Bitcoin, bringing the latest news and analyses on the future of money.
nft now is an award-winning web3 media platform on a mission to empower the creators of culture and bring NFTs from niche to mainstream.
The Block is the first and final word in digital assets.
Messari provides market intelligence that drives high-conviction participation in the crypto economy.
Blockworks is a data and software platform for investors and onchain businesses.
CoinDesk provides news and analysis on the trends, changes, technologies, companies, and people in the Bitcoin and digital currency world.
Art Blocks allows digital artists to have their work react to alphanumeric figures generated by the Ethereum blockchain.
SuperRare is one of the marketplaces for non-fungible tokens.
Mirror is a publication platform for creators, communities, and DAOs.
